LEGS per title, B against A in the window: V both zfmt as named (an arm without its init line is VOID), >= 45 perf lines each, B's draws per command buffer within 30% of A's (the two arms played the same stretch); M B's in/out >= 0.80 (one tile: the in-pass span is the whole pass); P B's mean outer span <= 0.65 x A's (the draw stream runs once, not twice; section 5 puts it at 0.5-0.65x); W B's median G <= 0.85 x A's, or B's median gfps >= A's + 8. PER-TITLE FIGURES, stated before any run (B in the window): NG Black gfps median >= 50 (A ~42), outer span <= 13 ms (A ~20); DOA3 gfps median >= 50, outer span <= 0.6 x A; ToeJam gfps median >= A + 8. WHAT REFUTES WHAT: B reads 0x81 but in/out stays <= 0.6 -> the tile count did not move, the mechanism (the stencil plane's alignment) is wrong; M passes but P fails -> one tile costs about what two did (loads/stores or bandwidth), the replay was not the GPU's cost; P passes but W fails -> the GPU was not the frame's wait in that window, and the lever saves GPU time without frames.
